title: SenseiCloud's QOL Texture Pack
description: A texture pack with most of the quality of life feature needed and nothing that doesnt. pvp utills/redstone utills, Dark UI, Clean Font and of course last but not the least fps boosting features
body: **SenseiCloud’s QOL Texture Pack** improves Minecraft’s visuals and gameplay clarity with clean, practical quality-of-life features. It includes smaller PvP items, low fire/shield, distinct mace textures, better redstone visibility, full grass, clear water/glass, dark GUI, clean fonts, visible ores, 3D blocks, improved bow/crossbow indicators, enhanced potion textures, and optimized enchantment glint for a cleaner overall experience.
